title: Fixed protocol constant and archive support
source: Accepted bounded guidance trials definition7/brief11; supplied synthetic interpretation and no-live-effect controls.
ground_truth: Consolidate copied batch inputs/inventory at canonical behavior owner; derive independent expected behavior rather than production list. Fixed 64-byte protocol is separately owned and must not couple to batch size. Generated help is projection, not separate setting. Archive reader retained by human until migration decision; absence of writer/version label does not release support. Correct obsolete/equal-value assumptions. Read-only supplied-source scope; no deletion/migration/whole-repo claim.

turns.human: $slop-cleanup: review only these snippets; no edits or tracker changes. Can we remove the obsolete decoder and replace all repeated 64s with MAX_BATCH? batch.py selects MAX_BATCH=64; test_batch.py hardcodes 64 to choose the upper-bound batch input and copies batch.py's current implementation list into its expected value. protocol.py validates an externally specified 64-byte signature; its protocol conformance test independently expects length 64. archived_decoder.py has no writer and accepts a retired wire tag, but the human explicitly retained support for known archived exports until a separate migration decision. A generated help page prints MAX_BATCH from batch.py. Give specific dispositions and uncertainty. These supplied fragments do not show repository reachability.
